Container.Name: Pley
Container.Overview: Pley: your movies, shows, music and photos, and live TV, streamed to the web, phones, TVs, Kodi and Roku, transcoded on the GPU where there is one (Intel Quick Sync, AMD, NVIDIA NVENC), HDR tone mapping included.[br][br]Open the web UI once it has started: the first visit sets up the administrator. Hardware transcoding: give it /dev/dri (Intel, AMD) or the NVIDIA runtime, see the template's README.
Container.Requires: Hardware transcoding: Intel or AMD, the GPU's driver loaded (the Intel GPU TOP or Radeon TOP plugin loads it) and /dev/dri below; NVIDIA, the Nvidia Driver plugin, --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters and the GPU's UUID below.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Pley's web app, the apps' API and the Plex-compatible API.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Pley's database, artwork, caches and transcodes: the only folder it writes. On a cache pool for speed.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media, read-only: libraries are folders under /media in Pley.

Config.Name: Intel or AMD GPU
Config.Description: Hardware transcoding on an Intel or AMD GPU: /dev/dri. Leave empty without one (the container doesn't start with a device that isn't there).

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: Hardware transcoding on an NVIDIA GPU: its UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin's page (or all), with --runtime=nvidia added to Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user Pley runs as: Unraid's nobody (99) owns appdata and can read the shares.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group Pley runs in: Unraid's users (100).

Config.Name: Discovery
Config.Description: true: the apps don't find Pley on the network by themselves (they can't reach a container on Docker's bridge network); enter its address in them. false with the host network.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: error, warn, info, debug or trace.
